paragraphs: DreamFactory™ is an open source REST API backend for mobile, web, and IoT applications. It is built on top of the Laravel framework, and includes an AngularJS-driven web administration client. So what can you do with the DreamFactory Platform?
features: Generate powerful, reusable, documented APIs for SQL, NoSQL, files, email, push notifications and more in seconds.
Use server-side scripts to easily customize API behavior at any endpoint, for both API requests and API responses.
Secure every API endpoint with user management, SSO authentication, role-based access control, OAuth and Active Directory integration.
